title: Tempo-Locked Wobble
brief: The dubstep wobble is a filter cutoff, modulated in time with the beat. Build VCO -> VCF -> Output (Saw Shape, Cut turned down dark). Add a Clock and an LFO. Patch the Clock's "Gate" jack into the LFO's "Sync" jack -- this locks the LFO's speed to the clock instead of its own free-running Rate knob. Turn the LFO's Div knob to "1/8" so it wobbles in eighth notes. Patch the LFO's "Out" into the VCF's "CV" jack, and turn the VCF's Amt knob up to around 4-5 -- that's how far the cutoff sweeps on each wobble. You should hear the filter chop in time, automatically, with no hands on the Cut knob.
